title: Documentation, changelog and decisions
problem: Changed behavior can leave documentation and decisions inaccurate.
rationale: Every change supplies the configured doc/changelog update or explicit reviewed N/A under project rules. Reuse existing changelog format; no automatic new documentation hierarchy.
applicability: Changed API/UI/configuration or behavior; reviewed N/A only under project rules.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: configured change-note/changelog fragment present for changed behavior; links/schema/docs build checks; relevant docs paths mapped to changed API/UI/config.
target_check.reviewer: content explains actual behavior and decisions. An empty fragment does not satisfy review.
target_check.limits: **D:** configured change-note/changelog fragment present for changed behavior; links/schema/docs build checks; relevant docs paths mapped to changed API/UI/config. **R:** content explains actual behavior and decisions. An empty fragment does not satisfy review.
target_check.configuration: Project-approved native configuration, immutable source/tool/config pins and applicable evidence mappings; Every change supplies the configured doc/changelog update or explicit reviewed N/A under project rules. Reuse existing changelog format; no automatic new documentation hierarchy.

expected_evidence: **D:** configured change-note/changelog fragment present for changed behavior; links/schema/docs build checks; relevant docs paths mapped to changed API/UI/config. **R:** content explains actual behavior and decisions. An empty fragment does not satisfy review.
repair: Update the project changelog and mapped documentation to describe actual behavior, then run native link/schema/docs checks and review content. Missing prerequisites remain Unsupported/Error.
